description: Historical end-of-line failure records from the drone test station. Each record is a past root-cause analysis written by a technician. Records are not tied to the simulator fault catalog; some describe failures the station cannot reproduce.

records.title: Motor will not spin, ESC sees no back-EMF
records.symptom_summary: Spin test shows one motor at zero rpm drawing almost no current and staying at room temperature. ESC telemetry for that channel reports back-EMF not detected and zero sync errors. Other three motors normal.
records.root_cause: Open stator winding (broken magnet wire at the solder cup).
records.rework_notes: Replace the motor at the dead position. Check the phase wire solder joints on the replacement.

records.title: Motor runs warm and draws extra current at normal speed
records.symptom_summary: One motor draws roughly 30 percent more current than the others at 50 percent throttle while rpm stays within spec. Temperature a bit higher than peers but under the limit. Slight increase in rpm jitter. Gritty feel when spun by hand.
records.root_cause: Worn or contaminated motor bearing adding mechanical drag.
records.rework_notes: Replace the motor. Rpm in spec separates this from a winding short.

records.title: Motor overheats with low rpm and very high current
records.symptom_summary: One motor draws about 50 percent extra current, rpm drops well below spec, and temperature exceeds the 58 C limit. Burnt varnish smell after the spin test.
records.root_cause: Turn-to-turn short in the stator winding from damaged insulation.
records.rework_notes: Replace the motor. Low rpm plus overheating separates this from a bearing issue.

records.title: Motor stutters and loses sync
records.symptom_summary: One motor stutters during spin up, rpm is low and unstable with very large rpm jitter. ESC telemetry on that channel shows many sync errors while back-EMF is detected. Packet loss is normal on all ESCs.
records.root_cause: ESC commutation timing set wrong in firmware, causing desync on that channel.
records.rework_notes: Reflash the ESC on the affected channel with the released firmware and timing profile.

records.title: All ESCs drop telemetry packets
records.symptom_summary: Every ESC reports high telemetry packet loss (several percent) but no sync errors. Motors spin normally. Harness check measures CAN termination near 120 ohm instead of 60 ohm. Power-on self test sometimes enumerates only three CAN nodes.
records.root_cause: CAN bus end terminator resistor not installed on the harness.
records.rework_notes: Install the 120 ohm terminator at the far end of the CAN harness. Termination should read 60 ohm afterward.

records.title: Gyro drifts on one axis at rest
records.symptom_summary: IMU static test shows a large gyro bias around 1 deg/s on a single axis while the unit sits still on the fixture. No dropped samples, accel noise normal, compass fine.
records.root_cause: Gyro calibration offsets not written to flash after the calibration step.
records.rework_notes: Rerun the 6-position calibration and confirm offsets are stored.

records.title: IMU and compass both drop reads intermittently
records.symptom_summary: IMU static test drops dozens of samples out of 1000 while gyro bias and accel noise look normal. Compass logs read errors on the same unit. Harness continuity on the I2C bus is intermittent, passing on some runs and showing high resistance on others. Power-on sometimes misses the IMU or compass on I2C.
records.root_cause: I2C sensor harness connector not fully seated and latched.
records.rework_notes: Reseat and latch the I2C connector. Problems on two I2C devices at once point to the shared bus, not a sensor.

records.title: IMU drops samples with noisy accelerometer
records.symptom_summary: IMU static test drops dozens of samples per 1000 and accelerometer noise is somewhat elevated. Compass has zero read errors and I2C harness continuity is clean, so the bus is fine.
records.root_cause: Failing IMU MEMS die (ESD damage during handling).
records.rework_notes: Replace the IMU daughterboard. Confirm compass is clean first to rule out a loose I2C connector.

records.title: One battery cell low at rest and collapses under load
records.symptom_summary: Rest check shows one cell about 0.07 V below the others, failing the rest imbalance limit. Under the 20 A load test that same cell sags far more than the rest, giving a large loaded cell imbalance. Pack internal resistance only mildly high.
records.root_cause: One cell in the pack lost capacity (manufacturing defect in cell lot).
records.rework_notes: Replace the pack and quarantine the cell lot.

records.title: Pack sags evenly under load, cells balanced
records.symptom_summary: Rest voltages normal and balanced, rest check passes. Under 20 A load the whole pack voltage sags below limit, internal resistance high across all cells, but loaded cell imbalance stays small.
records.root_cause: Aged pack with high internal resistance in every cell (old stock or many cycles).
records.rework_notes: Replace the pack. Balanced cells under load separate this from a single weak cell.

records.title: Camera self-test fails with CSI CRC errors
records.symptom_summary: Camera sensor ID reads correctly but self test fails. Frame rate below 28 fps and many CSI CRC errors on the data lanes.
records.root_cause: CSI ribbon cable creased or partially inserted in the connector.
records.rework_notes: Reseat the ribbon; replace it if creased.

records.title: Camera not detected, no frames
records.symptom_summary: Power-on self test cannot read the camera sensor ID. Camera self test fails with zero fps and zero CRC errors, meaning no data arrives at all.
records.root_cause: Dead image sensor on the camera module.
records.rework_notes: Replace the camera module.

records.title: Compass heading error grows with throttle
records.symptom_summary: Compass static heading error of several degrees with normal field magnitude. During the motor interference sweep heading deviation grows roughly linearly with throttle, over 20 degrees at 75 percent.
records.root_cause: Battery power lead routed next to the compass mast.
records.rework_notes: Reroute and twist the power pair away from the compass.

records.title: Constant compass heading offset, unaffected by motors
records.symptom_summary: Compass static heading error around 10 degrees, field magnitude somewhat high but within limits. Motor interference sweep passes: deviation does not change with throttle.
records.root_cause: Magnetized steel screw installed near the compass instead of a nonmagnetic one.
records.rework_notes: Swap in the correct fastener or degauss, then recalibrate the compass.

records.title: Motor current high after propeller strike
records.symptom_summary: One motor draws high current and runs hot after a drop at the previous station; rpm slightly low. Visible bent shaft.
records.root_cause: Bearing damaged by impact load.
records.rework_notes: Historical variant of FL-002 caused by handling damage.

records.title: IMU vibration noise high with motors on
records.symptom_summary: Accelerometer noise high and gyro noisy only when motors spin. Static IMU test on the fixture is clean with no dropped samples.
records.root_cause: IMU vibration damping foam not bonded; board rattles.
records.rework_notes: Rebond the damping foam. Not reproducible on the static fixture.

records.title: Motor current high on two motors, propellers unbalanced
records.symptom_summary: Two motors show elevated current and rpm jitter at speed with propellers installed. With propellers removed the spin test passes.
records.root_cause: Out-of-balance propellers from a bad molding batch.
records.rework_notes: Swap propellers. The station spin test runs without propellers, so this should not appear there.

records.title: ESC overheats and derates under sustained load
records.symptom_summary: One ESC temperature climbs above 80 C during long runs and the motor rpm drops as the ESC derates. Sync errors low, packet loss normal.
records.root_cause: Missing thermal pad between ESC FETs and the heatsink.
records.rework_notes: Install the thermal pad. ESC temperature is the tell.

records.title: Pack voltage sag from hot battery connector
records.symptom_summary: Pack voltage sags under load and the XT60 connector gets hot. Cell voltages measured at the balance lead stay balanced and individual cell resistance is normal; the extra resistance is in the main lead.
records.root_cause: Cold solder joint on the main power connector.
records.rework_notes: Resolder the connector. Looks like an aged pack, but cell IR from the balance lead is normal.

records.title: Camera frame rate low, no CRC errors
records.symptom_summary: Camera self test reports frame rate around 15 fps with zero CRC errors and sensor ID OK. Camera firmware version string does not match the release.
records.root_cause: Camera module shipped with old firmware set to a low frame rate mode.
records.rework_notes: Update camera firmware. Zero CRC errors separates it from a ribbon fault.

records.title: UART device missing at power-on
records.symptom_summary: Power-on self test does not find the camera control device on UART. Harness continuity on UART reads open. Camera self test cannot start.
records.root_cause: Bent pin in the UART harness connector.
records.rework_notes: Replace the UART harness lead.

records.title: Compass field magnitude far out of range
records.symptom_summary: Compass field magnitude above 70 uT and heading error very large. Speaker magnet from the nearby test bench was found next to the fixture.
records.root_cause: Magnetic object near the test fixture, not a unit defect.
records.rework_notes: Clear the fixture area and retest. No unit rework.

records.title: Motor rpm low with demagnetized rotor
records.symptom_summary: One motor spins faster than the others at the same throttle with slightly higher current; back-EMF constant low. Temperature normal.
records.root_cause: Rotor magnets partially demagnetized by overheating during an earlier burn-in.
records.rework_notes: Replace the motor. Rare; check burn-in logs.

records.title: Single ESC packet loss from chafed CAN wire
records.symptom_summary: Only one ESC shows telemetry packet loss and occasional sync errors; the others are clean. CAN termination reads a normal 60 ohm.
records.root_cause: Chafed CAN stub wire to one ESC.
records.rework_notes: Replace the stub. Loss on all ESCs plus 120 ohm termination points instead to a missing terminator.

records.title: Weak cell found after storage at full charge
records.symptom_summary: After long storage one cell rests lower than the rest and drops sharply under load; loaded imbalance well over 0.06 V.
records.root_cause: Cell degradation from storage at full charge.
records.rework_notes: Historical variant of FL-009.

records.title: Gyro bias after firmware update
records.symptom_summary: After a flight controller firmware update the gyro shows a static bias on one axis above 0.3 deg/s. Samples complete, no dropouts.
records.root_cause: Firmware update cleared stored gyro calibration.
records.rework_notes: Historical variant of FL-006.
